name: @openrig/studio-video
description: The video/timeline provider for OpenRig Studio surfaces. Serves the verbs mini-nle, media-manager and canvas call. Ported from studio-box; not extracted, not rewritten.

openrig._note: DECLARED, not discovered. Everything below is something an installer would otherwise have to infer from the code — and inferring it is how you get a hardcoded path. The empty-slot principle: if there is a field for it, nobody inlines it.

args.--port: required; the provider binds loopback only

roots._note: KINDS, not paths. The install binds these to real directories on the user's machine. Every hardcoded path removed from this tree existed because there was nowhere to say this.

project.description: the bundle being edited; timeline.json, history, exports live here

media.description: source footage and stills; never inside the app

canvas.description: freeform canvas documents, shared across projects

ffprobe.used_for: duration and codec probing of indexed assets

rig.used_for: the note verbs file work into the owner's own rig queue

open.used_for: reveal-in-Finder; not served in this studio

binaries._resolution: ffmpeg/ffprobe are resolved by resolveSystemBin from TRUSTED BIN DIRS only (/opt/homebrew/bin, /usr/local/bin, /usr/bin) and it throws a named error otherwise. Worth knowing on a distro that installs elsewhere.

first_run._note: Without this the timeline verbs answer ENOENT on a new project — honest, but not a usable app.
first_run.creates: timeline.json, history, slots, doctrine, media/ and exports/ skeleton

cutdown._note: /api/curation proxies to the cutdown backend over loopback. It defaults to 127.0.0.1:8795 and MUST be bound explicitly — left to the default it will happily read whatever else is on that port and answer ok:true.
cutdown.degrades: absent cutdown -> {ok:false, cuts:[]} -> media-manager falls back to a plain grid

vendored.vendor/b64Vecs.mjs: tldraw vector codec, used server-side by canvas-rails. The browser bundle is NOT here - it is an app asset and ships with apps/canvas.

_deps_note: ffmpeg/ffprobe ship WITH this provider rather than being assumed on PATH. Verified: ffmpeg-static 5.3.0 is ffmpeg 6.0 and carries drawtext/scale/xfade/concat. A stock Linux box commonly has node+npm+git and neither binary — this is what makes npm ci sufficient there.
